# SPONTÁN / SPONTANEOUS / SPONTAN — VIPACH Photo Exhibition 2026

Official multilingual microsite for the third major Vienna group exhibition of VIPACH — Vienna Photo Art & Creative Hub.

## Event facts
- Hungarian title: SPONTÁN
- English title: SPONTANEOUS
- German title: SPONTAN
- Exhibition dates: 15–22 November 2026
- Guest reception: 15 November 2026 from 16:00 (Europe/Vienna)
- Official opening: 15 November 2026 at 17:00 (Europe/Vienna)
- Admission: free
- Advance registration: not required
- Venue: CITYgalleryVIENNA by publicartists
- Address: Mahlerstraße 11, 1010 Wien, Austria
- Organizer: VIPACH — Vienna Photo Art & Creative Hub
- Contact: office@vipach.at
- WhatsApp / phone: +43 677 616 55592
- VIPACH event page: https://www.vipach.at/event-details/spontan-vipach-fotokiallitas-2026
- Official VIPACH website: https://www.vipach.at/

On the opening evening, several exhibition openings take place at the venue at the same time, so multiple artistic disciplines are represented alongside photography.

## Language pages
- English: https://exhibition.vipach.at/
- German (Austria): https://exhibition.vipach.at/de/
- Hungarian: https://exhibition.vipach.at/hu/

## Photography History evidence network
The exhibition microsite links only to subjects that have a published Photography History article in all three languages.
- Hungarian category: https://blog.banhalmi.art/blog/categories/fototortenelem
- English category: https://blog.banhalmi.art/en/blog/categories/photography-history
- German category: https://blog.banhalmi.art/de/blog/categories/fotogeschichte
- 19 verified multilingual articles are linked directly from the exhibition pages.

## Machine-readable identity
The microsite exposes a consistent Schema.org graph for:
- WebSite
- WebPage
- Organization
- Place
- ExhibitionEvent

The ExhibitionEvent uses a stable @id of https://exhibition.vipach.at/#event and links to the VIPACH event page as supporting sameAs evidence. The organizer entity links to VIPACH official social profiles. The event is marked free, offline, scheduled, with doorTime 16:00 and official startDate 17:00.
